JSON Record Schema
One Supabase row = one JSON object = one map marker. This is the core data unit of the entire platform.
// Business record — restaurants table (Supabase PostgreSQL) { "id": 1042, "name": "Grand Central Market", "address": "317 S Broadway, Los Angeles, CA 90013", "lat": 34.0506, "lng": -118.2488, "category": "food_hall", "zip": "90013", "state": "CA", "city": "Los Angeles", "phone": "+12135243321", "url": "https://grandcentralmarket.com", "yelp_id": "grand-central-market-los-angeles", // used for Yelp enrichment "neon_tier": "SOAPBOX", // MONUMENT | BILLBOARD | SOAPBOX | null "active": true }
// How the client reads it — PostgREST REST API, no Node.js needed for reads const res = await fetch(`${SB_URL}/rest/v1/restaurants?state=eq.CA&select=*`, { headers: { 'apikey': SB_KEY, 'Authorization': `Bearer ${SB_KEY}` } }); const rows = await res.json(); // → Array of business JSON objects rows.forEach(b => { const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className = 'poi-marker'; // CesiumJS DOM overlay — projected each postRender frame const pos = Cesium.Cartesian3.fromDegrees(b.lng, b.lat, 0); viewer.scene.postRender.addEventListener(() => { const sc = Cesium.SceneTransforms.worldToWindowCoordinates(viewer.scene, pos); if(sc){ el.style.left = sc.x + 'px'; el.style.top = sc.y + 'px'; } }); // one row → one DOM pin over 3D tile mesh });

Business Model
Directory — Every licensed US business gets a free base listing as a 3D map marker.

NEON MAPS — Paid advertising overlay. Three tiers:

MONUMENT
Monument
280×158px · Full-motion video loop
BILLBOARD
Billboard
210×118px · Static or animated
SOAPBOX
Soapbox
140×79px · Event-driven card
Data Pipeline
Ingest — Business data entered as JSON rows in Supabase. AZ and CA data isolated by state column. Never mixed.

Enrich — Yelp Fusion adds ratings, photos, hours via Vercel /api/yelp proxy. No enrichment data stored in DB.

Places — Google Places (New) v1 via /api/places. Returns up to 20 POIs in 800m radius. ⚠ DOM dot markers currently desktop-only — not rendering on Asus/iPhone. Target: persist results to Supabase places table + dedup against Yelp by name + coordinates (≤50m).

Serve — PostgREST REST API streams JSON directly to browser. No ORM, no framework, direct fetch().

Render — Vanilla JS DOM overlay pins via CesiumJS SceneTransforms.worldToWindowCoordinates. 1 row → 1 pin.

Advertise — neon_tier field on the record controls which NEON MAPS template renders at that lat/lng.
Tech Stack
Frontend — Vanilla HTML / CSS / JavaScript. No React, no Vue, no webpack. Intentional: fast load, zero dependency rot.

Maps — Google Maps JS API. Map ID 96844e6a7bb74a7d5514d3a5 (vector). AdvancedMarkerElement pins. Cinematic moveCamera reveal. Street View + Aerial View on property card. Yelp favorites + events strip on /dtla and /laveen.

Database — Supabase PostgreSQL. PostgREST REST. Publishable anon key (safe to embed in client HTML).

Serverless — Vercel Functions, Node.js 18. api/ dir → /api/* routes. Secrets in Vercel env vars — never in client HTML.

Deploy — GitHub push → Vercel auto-build (~10s) → node build.js → dist/ → CDN. vercel.json controls clean URLs.

Domain — requation.com · Vercel CDN · TLS auto-renew. Cloudflare DNS migration pending (DDoS + edge cache).
